categories.name: rpc
categories.evidence: Matches the RPC/REST/ZMQ label and directly modifies the scanblocks RPC implementation in src/rpc/blockchain.cpp.
categories.rationale: Fixes a correctness bug where scanblocks silently dropped unread block chunks and returned completed: true when filter lookups failed. As noted in the description, this created 'a silent gap: a caller gets a relevant_blocks list that looks fine but is missing any match in the unindexed range, with no way to distinguish "no matches" from "range was never scanned".'
